images.title: Paul Collins / Paths and Bridge in Woodgate Valley Country Park
images.caption: Paths and Bridge in Woodgate Valley Country Park. Here a pleasant path within Woodgate Valley Country Park runs beside the Bourn Brook. The path and stream are here crossed by another path running north-south.

description: This cycle or walk runs along a surfaced path from Harbourne Lane to Woodgate Valley Country Park. The walk starts off in Selly Oak near the university and the Worcester and Birmingham Canal. From here you head west along the Bourn Brook passing a series of weirs and the suburb of California. The route finishes near Woodgate Valley Country Park where there are 450 acres of rich meadows, woodland and small ponds. For a similar route in the city see the Harborne Walkway page.
